title: Payment DB pool exhaustion after deploy
text: Latency and errors after deployment, db connection timeout, pool exhausted. Resolved by rolling back to the previous version. Pool recovered within 3 minutes.

title: Search OOM
text: OutOfMemoryError heap usage above 95 percent. Resolved by restart; leak ticketed.

title: Worker CPU saturation
text: CPU 97 percent with queue depth growing and no deployment. Resolved by scaling from 2 to 4 replicas.

title: Pricing NPE behind feature flag
text: NullPointerException with feature flag enabled caused 5xx errors. Resolved by disabling the feature flag.

title: Impossible Travel Activity Detected (synthetic confirmed incident)
text: Symptoms matched the playbook: This alert fires when the same user account signs in from two locations that are too far apart to have been reached through normal travel in the time between th Confirmed true positive after checking Previous authentication. Resolution: Revoke active sessions and force MFA re-registration for the affected account (simulated; not yet automated in the sandbox). Outcome: contained. Playbook soc_impossible_travel_activity_detected v1.

text: Same alert fired but the user, device and IP matched known benign activity (for example travel or an approved tool). Closed as false positive after playbook checks. Playbook soc_impossible_travel_activity_detected v1.
